title: 第二十三章 合窳之宴第二十四章 浮动岛屿
lines: 第二十三章：合窳之宴
浑夕之海比记忆中更加死寂。
木筏在粘稠的海面上艰难前行，每一次划桨都像是在搅拌凝固的胶水。剡山的赤铜盔甲在橙黄色的天光下反射着诡异的光泽，石枭蹲在筏尾，那双鹰隼般的眼睛死死盯着前方海平线上那座越来越近的、由枯骨和黑岩构成的浮动岛屿。
“那就是‘合窳之巢’。”石枭的声音压得很低，生怕惊动了海里的什么东西，“传说中‘食人’的怪物，其实只是……饥饿的清道夫。”
“清道夫？”黄海涛擦拭着射日弩机括上的盐渍，左臂的骨折在剡山族长的草药处理后已经愈合了大半，但阴雨天仍会隐隐作痛。
“它们吃垃圾，也吃被垃圾毒死的东西。”石枭指了指海水里漂浮的一些发黑的、像是塑料袋又像是水母的胶体，“这个世界的‘病’，就是从海里开始的。合窳吃了病鱼，自己也病了，变得更饿，更疯。这是个循环。”
李元茜突然指着前方：“那是什么？”
在浮动岛屿的边缘，海面上漂浮着一团巨大的、灰白色的泡沫。泡沫里，隐约包裹着几个扭曲的人形轮廓。随着木筏靠近，他们看清了——那是几具穿着现代潜水服的尸体，但身体已经高度肿胀，皮肤和潜水服粘连在一起，呈现出一种橡胶般的质感。他们的头盔面罩上，还残留着临死前极度惊恐的表情。
“又是‘天外来客’。”石枭脸色阴沉，“看来，不止我们一拨人想找‘核心’。”
就在这时，浮动岛屿上突然传来一阵尖锐的、类似金属摩擦的怪啸。
哗啦——！
岛屿边缘的岩壁突然炸开，一头庞然大物猛地冲入海中。
那是合窳。
它并没有《山海经》里描述的“人面猪身”，而是呈现出一种极其扭曲的、拼凑般的外形。它的主体像是一头巨大的、长着六条腿的野猪，但脖子上却嫁接了一个类似穿山甲的头颅，嘴里没有牙齿，只有一圈圈高速旋转的、像砂纸一样的肉垫。最可怕的是它的身体两侧，还长着几只发育不全的、像是人手一样的附肢，此刻正无助地在空中抓挠。
“那是……拼图怪？”李元茜瞪大了眼睛，“基因污染导致的嵌合体？”
“不，是‘回收’。”一个虚弱的声音从泡沫团里传来。
众人猛地转头。
泡沫团里，一个身影正在艰难地挣扎。他扯掉破碎的潜水头盔，露出一张被海水泡得发白、但依稀可辨的脸——是张弛。
但他已经不是那个意气风发的科技狂人了。他的半边脸已经兽化，长出了类似野猪的獠牙，一只眼睛变成了浑浊的白色，另一只还保留着人类的形状，但里面充满了绝望和疯狂。
“黄……海涛……李元茜……”张弛的声音嘶哑，他试图游过来，但四肢被泡沫里的粘性物质死死缠住，“救我……帮我……拿到核心……我就能……修好门……”
“张弛，你做了什么？”黄海涛厉声问道，射日弩的准星已经对准了他的胸口。
“我……我听了陈宇的。”张弛哭喊着，眼泪混着海水一起流下，“他说只要融合……就能获得力量……我融合了……但我控制不住……这身体……它在想吃人……”
他猛地抬起手，那只人手正在发生恐怖的异变，指甲暴涨成利爪，皮肤长出硬毛，眼看就要失控。
“杀了我……”张弛哀求道，那只兽化的爪子离他的喉咙只有一寸，“趁我还……还有人性……”
石枭动了。
他没有用射日弩，而是从腰间抽出一根套索，手腕一抖，绳子像蛇一样飞出，精准地套住了张弛的脖子，将他整个人从泡沫团里拖了出来，重重摔在木筏上。
“别杀他。”石枭按住想要冲上去的黄海涛，眼神冷酷，“他还有用。合窳是群居的，而且有等级。他是‘祭品’，或者是……‘诱饵’。”
仿佛印证他的话，远处的浮动岛屿上，更多的合窳冲了出来。它们那畸形的身躯在海面上激起白色的浪花，那几十双眼睛（有的长在头上，有的长在背上）齐刷刷地锁定了木筏上的几人，尤其是……那个刚刚被扔上来的、散发着“同类”气息的张弛。
“跑！”石枭大吼一声，猛地扳动射日弩的扳机。
嘣！
一支冰晶箭矢呼啸而出，没有射向合窳群，而是射向了岛屿边缘的岩壁。
轰！
箭矢在岩壁上炸开，引发了一场小规模的山体滑坡。巨大的石块砸进海里，激起滔天巨浪，暂时阻断了合窳群的冲锋。
木筏借着这股冲击波，像脱缰的野马，向岛屿深处冲去。
岛屿内部，是一个巨大的、死去的生态系统。
这里没有树木，只有无数根巨大的、像烟囱一样的管状结构，从地底喷涌出黑色的粘稠烟雾。空气中弥漫着令人窒息的毒气，地面覆盖着一层厚厚的、像煤灰一样的粉末。
在岛屿的中心，有一个巨大的、深不见底的竖井。竖井边缘，堆放着无数新鲜的、还在滴血的猎物残骸——有变异的鱼，有畸形的鸟，甚至还有几具明显属于“合窳”的尸体。
而在那尸堆顶端，坐着一个身影。
是陈宇。
但他已经完全脱离了人形。他的下半身已经和某种巨大的、像蜗牛一样的壳融合在一起，上半身勉强保持着人形，但皮肤呈现出一种病态的、半透明的灰绿色。他的头上长着两根长长的、像触角一样的肉须，正在空气中高频颤动。
在他面前，悬浮着一颗篮球大小的、散发着幽幽蓝光的晶体——那就是“浑夕之核”。

Chapter 23: Banquet of Heyong
1.
The sea of ​​Hunxi is more dead than in memory.
The raft trudged forward on the sticky sea, and each stroke was like stirring solidified glue. Shanshan's red copper armor reflected a strange luster under the orange skylight. The stone owl squatted on the tail of the raft, its falcon-like eyes staring at the increasingly approaching floating island made of dead bones and black rocks on the horizon ahead.
"That's the 'Lair of Heyuan'." Shi Xiao's voice was very low, for fear of disturbing something in the sea. "The legendary 'man-eating' monster is actually just... a hungry scavenger."
"Scavenger?" Huang Haitao wiped the salt stains on the arms of the sun-shooting crossbow. Most of the fractures in his left arm had healed after the herbal treatment given by the chief of the Yanshan clan, but there was still a dull pain on rainy days.
"They eat garbage, and they also eat things poisoned by garbage." Shi Xiao pointed to some black colloids floating in the sea that looked like plastic bags or jellyfish. "The 'disease' in this world started in the sea. When He Yue ate the diseased fish, he also became sick, becoming hungrier and crazier. This is a cycle."
Li Yuanqian suddenly pointed forward: "What is that?"
At the edge of the floating island, a huge, gray-white foam floated on the sea. In the bubble, there are several twisted humanoid outlines vaguely wrapped. As the raft approached, they saw clearly - they were several corpses wearing modern diving suits, but the bodies were highly swollen, and the skin and diving suits were stuck together, giving a rubbery texture. Their helmet visors still showed the extremely frightened expressions they had before they died.
"It's another 'visitor from outside'." Shi Xiao's face was gloomy. "It seems that we are not the only ones who want to find the 'core'."
At this moment, a sharp, strange roar similar to metal friction suddenly came from the floating island.
Wow——!
The rock wall at the edge of the island suddenly exploded, and a huge creature rushed into the sea.
That is Heyong.
It does not have the "human face and pig body" described in "The Classic of Mountains and Seas", but presents an extremely twisted, patchwork-like appearance. Its main body resembles a huge wild boar with six legs, but a pangolin-like head is grafted onto its neck. There are no teeth in its mouth, only circles of high-speed rotating, sandpaper-like flesh pads. The most terrifying thing is that there are several underdeveloped, human-like appendages on both sides of its body, which are scratching helplessly in the air at this moment.
"Is that... Jigsaw Monster?" Li Yuanqian's eyes widened, "A chimera caused by genetic contamination?"
"No, it's 'recycling'." A weak voice came from the foam ball.
Everyone turned their heads suddenly.
In the bubble, a figure was struggling hard. He pulled off his broken diving helmet, revealing a face that was whitened by the sea water but vaguely recognizable - it was relaxed.
But he is no longer the high-spirited technology geek. Half of his face has turned into a beast, growing fangs similar to those of a wild boar. One eye has turned cloudy white, and the other still retains the shape of a human, but it is full of despair and madness.
"Huang...Haitao...Li Yuanqian..." Zhang Chi's voice was hoarse. He tried to swim over, but his limbs were tightly entangled in the sticky substance in the foam. "Save me...help me...get the core...I can...fix the door..."
"Zhang Chi, what did you do?" Huang Haitao asked sharply, the sight of the sun-shooting crossbow already aimed at his chest.
"I...I listened to Chen Yu." Zhang Chi cried, tears mixed with the sea water and flowed down. "He said that as long as we fuse... we can gain power... I fused... but I can't control... this body... it wants to eat people..."
He suddenly raised his hand, and that human hand was undergoing horrific changes. The nails swelled into sharp claws, and the skin grew bristles, and he was about to lose control.
"Kill me..." Zhang Chi begged, the animal-like claws were only an inch away from his throat, "while I still... still have humanity..."
The stone owl moved.
Instead of using a sun-shooting crossbow, he pulled out a lasso from his waist. With a flick of his wrist, the rope flew out like a snake and accurately wrapped around his stretched neck. He dragged his whole body out of the foam ball and threw him heavily on the raft.
"Don't kill him." Shi Xiao held down Huang Haitao, who was about to rush forward, with cold eyes. "He is still useful. Heyong lives in groups and has levels. He is a 'sacrifice' or...'bait'."
As if to confirm his words, more Heyong rushed out from the floating island in the distance. Their deformed bodies stirred up white waves on the sea, and dozens of pairs of eyes (some on the head, some on the back) locked onto several people on the raft, especially... the one who had just been thrown up, Zhang Zai, who exuded the aura of "the same kind".
"Run!" Shi Xiao roared and suddenly pulled the trigger of the sun-shooting crossbow.
Boom!
An ice crystal arrow roared out, not towards the Heyong group, but towards the rock wall at the edge of the island.
boom!
The arrow exploded on the rock wall, triggering a small landslide. Huge rocks smashed into the sea, causing huge waves and temporarily blocking the charge of the Heyong group.
Taking advantage of this shock wave, the raft rushed towards the depths of the island like a wild horse running wild.
2.
Inside the island is a huge, dead ecosystem.
There are no trees here, just countless huge, chimney-like tube-like structures, spewing thick black smoke from the ground. The air was filled with suffocating poisonous gas, and the ground was covered with a thick layer of soot-like powder.
In the center of the island, there is a huge, bottomless shaft. At the edge of the shaft, there are countless fresh and bleeding prey remains piled up - there are mutated fish, deformed birds, and even a few corpses that clearly belong to "Heyong"
